tasks.label: Flash Existing AR MainBoard (Release)
tasks.detail: Flash the last built Release image over ST-LINK without rebuilding, verify and reset. Disconnect motor-driver power first.

tasks.label: Build + Flash AR MainBoard (Release)
tasks.detail: Build current sources, then flash over ST-LINK, verify and reset. Disconnect motor-driver power first.

tasks.label: Build AR MainBoard (Release)
tasks.detail: Find the Arm C toolchain, configure and compile Release. This step does not flash.

tasks.label: Build + Flash AR Encoder Bench
tasks.detail: Build the passive EncoderBench preset, then program only its ELF over ST-LINK, verify and reset. Leave motor-driver power disconnected.

tasks.label: Build AR Encoder Bench
tasks.detail: Find the Arm C toolchain and build the separate EncoderBench preset. This step does not flash.
